summary: Frontend polish-pass validation for DHL Express PNG demo (iteration 4). Comprehensive Playwright UI testing on landing IA redesign, hero carousel, dismissible disruption banner, quick-action strip, MyDHL section, info-card modals, trust strip, refined footer with country dropdown, dashboard KPI sparklines, per-route page titles, refined 404, and regression on all existing routes. ALL 13 spec items PASS. Backend skipped as instructed.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs 8x warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on each sparkline mount. Charts still render visually correctly but warning indicates the sparkline container's initial measurement returns -1 — likely a 0px parent during first paint or missing minWidth/minHeight. Cosmetic console noise; not a user-facing bug. Consider wrapping MiniSparkline in a fixed-size div (e.g., width:80, height:24) instead of width=100% on ResponsiveContainer.

action_items: Optional cleanup: silence Recharts -1 width/height warnings on MiniSparkline (use fixed dimensions instead of ResponsiveContainer 100%).
critical_code_review_comments: Landing IA refactor is clean — Landing.jsx is a thin composer (39 lines) delegating to DHLHeader / ServiceDisruptionBanner / HeroCarousel / QuickActionStrip / MyDHLPlatform / InfoCardsRow / TrustStrip / RichFooter. Good separation.

HeroCarousel autoplay uses single setTimeout that resets on index change — correct pattern. Pause-on-hover works (verified via mouseenter). Progress bar key={index} forces CSS animation restart per slide — good UX.
DHLHeader sticky shrink: utility-bar collapses from 40px → 0 and main bar from 80px → 64px past scrollY 80px — verified visually. Spacer div h-[120px] in Landing.jsx is sized for the unshrunk header.

InfoCardsRow uses one action contract {type:'route'|'modal'} per card — clean. Business CTA navigates to /register (route), Batteries/Customs CTAs open shared info-modal — both modal triggers verified working with close.
ServiceDisruptionBanner persists dismissal via localStorage key dhl_disruption_banner_dismissed_v1 — verified survives reload.

Regional-leak fix VERIFIED — no POM/SYD/Port Moresby/Sydney text appears anywhere on / or /track (empty state). /track/DHL1234567890 still shows those for the actual shipment — correct privacy-scoped behavior.

/favicon.svg returns 200. <title> updates per route correctly: '/' → 'Express Shipping & Logistics | DHL Express', '/dashboard' → 'Dashboard | DHL Express', any unknown route → 'Lost in Transit | DHL Express'.
NotFound page renders with notfound-page testid, correct title and CTA buttons.
Mobile drawer (viewport 390px) shows Home / Ship / Track + Login + Register buttons — drawer test verified.
test_credentials: demo@dhlpng.com / Demo@2026 — verified login redirects /dashboard with welcome state. Token stored at localStorage 'dhl_auth_token'.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all features pass. Recharts sparkline width(-1) warning RCA: ResponsiveContainer's first measurement before parent flex/grid layout settles returns -1 sizes; Recharts logs a warning but recovers and renders. Quick fix: replace ResponsiveContainer with fixed width/height props on the inner LineChart, or wrap MiniSparkline in a div with explicit pixel dimensions.
